title: The Anthropocene Reviewed
author: John Green
summary: John Green reviews facets of the human-made world, from Canada geese to the Hawaiian pizza, on a five-star scale. Each essay mixes history with his own life, including his experience of anxiety and illness.
readIf: you like warm, personal essays that find meaning in small things.
skipIf: you want a single argument or fast plot rather than a collection of short pieces.
